cell_type: SDS-PAGE, immunoblots and high-resolution mass spectrometric analysis was performed with 16 house dust mite (HDM) SPT solutions and AVs from 3 Indian manufacturers.
disease_state: Skin prick test (SPT) solutions and allergy vaccines (AVs) are crucial tools for diagnosis and therapy of allergies.
material_type: All samples were "ready-to-use" for physicians and contained glycerol and phenol.
sample_source: All samples were purchased by collaborating physicians in India from local vendors and shipped to Europe under temperature-controlled conditions at 4 °C.
species: As reference for D. pteronyssinus and D. farinae, authority-approved SPT solutions from Allergopharma (Reinbek, Germany) were used (ref-DP, ref-DF).
